description: This Python script defines hooks and utilities for customizing MkDocs build process, including handling multilingual support, resolving files, modifying navigation, and injecting missing translation notices.

classes.name: EnFile
classes.description: A subclass of mkdocs.structure.files.File that may be customized for English files.

methods.name: str get_missing_translation_content(docs_dir: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the 'missing-translation.md' file from the docs directory.

methods.name: list[str] get_mkdocs_material_langs()
methods.description: Returns a list of available language codes based on Material theme templates.

methods.name: MkDocsConfig on_config(config: MkDocsConfig, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Modifies the MkDocs configuration to set language and site URL based on directory structure.

methods.name: None resolve_file(*, item: str, files: Files, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Resolves a specific file in the docs directory, or falls back to English if not found.

methods.name: None resolve_files(*, items: list[Any], files: Files, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Processes a list of items to resolve multiple files, supporting nested structures.

methods.name: Files on_files(files: Files, *, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Enhances the files list before building, resolving logo, favicon, CSS, and JavaScript files.

methods.name: list[Union[Page,Section,Link]] generate_renamed_section_items( items: list[Union[Page, Section, Link]], *, config: MkDocsConfig )
methods.description: Modifies navigation sections, potentially renaming based on page titles.

methods.name: Navigation on_nav( nav: Navigation, *, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files, **kwargs: Any )
methods.description: Adjusts the navigation structure before rendering.

methods.name: Page on_pre_page(page: Page, *, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files)
methods.description: A hook executed before rendering each page (stub, no modifications).

methods.name: str on_page_markdown( markdown: str, *, page: Page, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files )
methods.description: Processes page markdown, injecting missing translation notices for certain files.

ctags.signature: ( items: list[Union[Page, Section, Link]], *, config: MkDocsConfig )

ctags.name: on_nav
ctags.signature: ( nav: Navigation, *, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files, **kwargs: Any )

ctags.name: on_page_markdown
ctags.signature: ( markdown: str, *, page: Page, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files )

ctags.pattern: /^def on_pre_page(page: Page, *, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files) -> Page:$/

ctags.signature: (*, item: str, files: Files, config: MkDocsConfig)

ctags.pattern: /^def resolve_files(*, items: list[Any], files: Files, config: MkDocsConfig) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (*, items: list[Any], files: Files, config: MkDocsConfig)
